output.reason: [ev-ea324615706c] says the argocd-cm repository option "is no longer available in Argo CD 3.0". It gives a detection command covering repositories, repository.credentials and helm.repositories, and tells operators to convert those repositories to Secrets. That means values configured in those removed keys stop being honoured, which is what setting-ignored covers, so the class is action-required. The proposed remediation matches the evidence.
